title: zehneria odorata
intro: Zehneria odorata, commonly known as the stinking passion fruit, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of Asia and Australia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial and fungal infections, and exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of Zehneria odorata include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
